slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
scary smart

a word a day

learn one new word a day and use it in a sentence before bed. a bigger vocabulary doesn't just make you sound smarter, it gives you more ways to actually think.

foreign films

watch one film a week in a language you don't speak, with subtitles. you pick up the rhythm of other languages and see how differently people live and think.

where words come from

spend 5 minutes a day learning the story behind one word or one idea. knowing where things come from makes every conversation, book and headline suddenly make more sense.
slides.texte_sophia:
where words come from

i spend 5 minutes a day learning the story behind one word or one idea. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and every book and headline suddenly makes more sense.

slides.texte_overlay:
a language on the side

learn 10 words a day in a language you'd love to speak someday. even a little of a second language changes how you hear your own, and it keeps your memory sharp.

poetry out loud

read one poem out loud every evening. poetry squeezes huge ideas into a few lines, and reading it slowly teaches you to notice what most people rush straight past.
